hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a native ETH/WORD pool that skims a configurable fee (default 1%, max 2%) from the ETH side of every swap and accrues it in-contract. A public permissionless flush() routes the balance to rewards, bounty, and burn-engine streams based on whether burnable WORD excess exists. Includes a one-time owner trading gate and a 1-hour launch guard capping per-buy WORD output.
